title: Matchmakers say more tech workers fear romantic espionage after the Jensen Huang scandal; an AI companion app pitches "zero espionage" executive girlfriends (Wired)
summary: Wired: Matchmakers say more tech workers fear romantic espionage after the Jensen Huang scandal; an AI companion app pitches “zero espionage” executive girlfriends — The Jensen Huang scandal is the latest fuel for dating anxieties among newly rich and powerful tech workers.
